claims.summary: Over every field of characteristic three, for every d>=5 with d=5 mod27, the original generic root-curve series V_(7,d) has Hasse order set {0,...,64d-129}. The alternative full survivor merge a5->a3 is normal at a transcendental conic mark, repairing the family for which the a5->a1 boundary has generic corank one. Other degrees/residues/primes and pre-stable thresholds are not asserted.
claims.assessment: Conditional pending review. The full alternative profiles follow from the even-cut lemma and a six-row Lucas pivot calculation. Thirteen exact conic conditions have a uniform matrix across the family. Its C-linear coefficient is u^15(Y-u^3 X)(u^3 U+V)^2; both contact factors have exact order q=3^v3(N-3), and N-3=5 mod8 cannot be a power of three, forcing the first term below every remaining C-degree. A direct Laurent-source control validates the encoding at d5,p3.
